# Agent Note: Titlebar Git progress toast

Status: implemented

English | [中文](2026-08-16-git-action-progress-toast.zh.md)

## Problem

Stacked Git actions (Commit, push & PR; Push; Pull) run `git commit` / `git push` with leftover hooks that can take tens of seconds. The titlebar showed no live status, then opened a blocking modal with the full hook dump. The titlebar now shows a top-right loading card immediately (spinner, phase title, `Running for Ns` or the latest hook line) and keeps success or failure on that same card.

## Decision

`GitProgressToast` is a package-internal card in `ui-git`, styled with `--dsw-alias-*` tokens. The official `Toast` atom is a top-center 3s fade and cannot stay up through a hook, so Git progress does not use it.

`GitActionsControl` opens the card in the same click that starts the stacked action, Pull, or Initialize Git, before any IPC returns. Stacked Commit/Push/PR builds stages from the last-known status, shows the card, then re-reads status (`gitFetchForStatus` for push/create_pr, local `gitStatus` for commit-only). While that stacked action holds `busy`, `BranchMenu` is `disabled` so a switch or create cannot retarget the in-flight commit, push, or PR. Desktop `gitCommit` / `gitPush` / `gitPull` stream sanitized stdout/stderr lines through `shell:git-progress` keyed by `actionId`, and also tail `GIT_TRACE2_EVENT` so leftover/husky hooks retitle the card on `child_start`. `child_exit` reads Git's production `exit_code` (then `exitCode` / `code` aliases) so a failed leftover hook can retitle to `hook exited N`. `hook_finished` clears the last line and restores the current phase title. Those three commands wait 10 minutes (`COMMIT_TIMEOUT_MS`); `gitPull` is `git pull --ff-only`. The git child inherits a sanitized env without Electron `npm_config_electron_*` and without `GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES`. Success titles stay on the action that ran. Push/PR success CTAs wait for a settled fetch + PR lookup on the post-action ref, so a default-ref feature-branch continue can offer Create PR, and a push onto an existing PR can offer View PR. Commit-only success uses local porcelain so the card is not blocked on fetch or `gh`. Error stays until close. Copy writes the dump. Show details keeps the short headline and expands the remaining dump below; the control is omitted when the dump equals that headline. `gitFailureMessage` returns the CRLF-filtered dump, including `hint:` lines, rather than one marked line. Init, the commit-dialog file list, branch switch/create, and open-file failures all land on that same card.

Default-ref confirm offers Checkout feature branch & continue only when the action includes a commit. Feature-branch checkout is rejected for push-only and create-PR-only; those dialogs' copy does not mention creating a feature ref. A feature-branch commit emits `Preparing feature ref...` while it generates (when the message is empty) and creates the ref, then `Committing...` with the pre-resolved suggestion; `includeBranch` asks the model for `branch` and falls back to the sanitized subject.

Empty commit and PR copy run DeepSeek chat when the desktop API key is set and fail the action if that request fails; without a key they use a staged name-status / range heuristic. The client does not send a commit subject as the PR title; `gitCreateChangeRequest` emits `Preparing PR...` then generates from the range and refuses a dirty work tree. PR templates are read from the committed base tree (`ls-tree` + `cat-file blob`); an ambiguous template directory yields no template. `create_pr` fails closed on a dirty tree before push. PR generation and `gh pr create --base` share one `resolvePrBaseBranch` result: `gh-merge-base`, then a same-repo upstream name that differs from the local ref, then `gh repo view` `defaultBranchRef` (30s `gh` timeout), then git primary-remote `HEAD` / local `main|master`, then `main`. Staged and range patches cap at 49k/59k bytes and append `[truncated]`. `gitStatus` stays local porcelain, except that a ref with no upstream reports `aheadCount` as commits vs `branch.<name>.gh-merge-base` or the default ref; `aheadOfDefaultCount` is 0 on the default ref. When that `rev-list` fails, status sets `aheadUnreliable` instead of a silent zero: the titlebar keeps Push, Create PR stays hidden, and `gitPush` does not skip. `git status -sb` `[gone]` is treated as no usable upstream, so ahead is counted vs the default/base and push can republish with `-u`. The titlebar refreshes the tracking remote (else primary) with `git fetch --quiet --no-tags` keyed by git-common-dir + remote name (5s timeout, 15s success TTL, 30s failure base backoff capped at 15 minutes) and loads `gh pr view` in the background. Window focus/visibility refresh waits 250ms, and is skipped while a stacked action is `busy` so it cannot abort post-action PR settlement. Custom commit messages stay verbatim (they are not run through model sanitization). Stacked actions re-read status before dirty/push gates. GitHub PR create/list pass `--head` (fork → `owner:branch`). `isCrossRepository` requires a parsed `owner/repo` on the non-origin remote; an unparseable URL is not treated as a fork. That same parse decides `resolvePrBaseBranch`: an unparseable non-origin still uses the tracking branch as `--base`. Create PR is offered only when status includes `sourceControlProvider.kind === 'github'`; an omitted provider and non-GitHub remotes fail closed. Publish defaults to private unless IPC `visibility` is explicitly `public`. Publish is offered only when status is a live repo without origin, not when status is null. Menu and main-button View PR share the missing-URL toast. A disabled main-button hint wraps the native disabled control so hover still works. Disabled chevron-menu rows wrap the same way with `getMenuActionDisabledReason`. The chevron menu adds detached-HEAD and behind-upstream footers, and a repo with no origin also keeps Publish repository in that menu so a dirty worktree can still open the publish dialog. Progress cards start with `Waiting for Git...` until the first git event supplies a start timestamp.

`prepareCommitContext` stages once, then `git commit` does not re-add. A custom commit message uses a first-line subject / remaining-lines body split (not only a blank-line split). Feature-branch commit fails closed when there is nothing staged. A missing `gh` after commit+push fails the stacked action. Publish repository opens a dialog that runs `gh repo create --yes` or adds a pasted remote URL. Submit closes that dialog onto the progress card; failure reopens the same dialog so the fields can be retried. A pasted origin with history keeps `url` after `gitPush` so the success card can Open repository. Stacked `commit_push` / `commit_push_pr` always call `gitCommit`; a clean tree returns skipped. `gitPush` skips when there is no local delta and the remote branch already exists, except when `aheadUnreliable` is true.

## Alternatives considered

**Reuse the official Toast atom.** Rejected: its timeout and placement cannot hold a hook that runs for tens of seconds, and a second toast skin would still not stream hook lines.

**Keep the blocking error modal as the only failure UI.** Rejected: the user's failure was the silent wait, not the dump itself. A toast error with the last hook line (or the first short dump line) is the failure path.

**Import a third-party toast manager or Tailwind card.** Rejected: it breaks the dsw token rule and the client export/slot rules. The card is local to `ui-git`.

## Consequences

Clicking Commit, push & PR now shows `Generating commit message...` and `Running for 0s` immediately, then hook titles as leftover runs. Hook failure replaces that card with Action failed instead of a page-eating modal. `git-actions.client.spec.tsx` pins the immediate toast, hook-line update, toast-not-modal failure, publish dialog closing onto the progress card and reopening on failure, fail-closed PR with generated copy, init/file-list toast errors, and feature-branch continue only on commit actions. `src/main/git.test.js` pins unparseable non-origin `--base` and untracked `gitDiscard` via `git clean`. Worktree/thread binding remains out of scope; see the [branch picker note](2026-08-16-titlebar-branch-picker.md) for switch/create.
